title: Simple Present Tense, Simple Past Tense and Simple Future Tense

lessons.title: Verb Forms Overview
lessons.content: There are three main tenses in English: Simple Present, Simple Past, and Simple Future. Each tense has a specific verb form.

details.burmese: ကျွန်မ စာတစ်စောင် ရေးတယ်။

details.example: I wrote a letter last night.
details.burmese: မနေ့ညက ကျွန်မ စာတစ်စောင် ရေးခဲ့တယ်။

details.example: I will write a letter next week.
details.burmese: နောက်အပတ် ကျွန်မ စာတစ်စောင် ရေးမယ်။

lessons.title: Subject-Verb Conjugation
lessons.content: Different subjects use different verb forms in each tense.

lessons.title: Sentence Forms
lessons.content: "Do" is used as an auxiliary verb to make negative and question sentences of Simple Present Tense and Simple Past Tense. In Simple Future Tense, we use will + V1.

forms.negative: Subject + don't/doesn't + verb (present) / didn't + verb (past) / won't + verb (future)
forms.interrogative: Do/Does + subject + verb (present) / Did + subject + verb (past) / Will + subject + verb (future)
forms.negative_interrogative: Don't/Doesn't + subject + verb (present) / Didn't + subject + verb (past) / Won't + subject + verb (future)

lessons.title: Answer Forms
lessons.content: When we are replying Yes/No Questions, we can use short or long form for the answer.
